title: Phases
description: phases.json: exact UTC windows of warmup, each stage and cooldown.

scrape_warnings.description: Relevant Prometheus scrape roles that have no job, found when the scrape interval was resolved (the structured form of the text warning servtuner validate prints). The run still ran; series of that role may be missing or scraped more slowly than reported.

warnings.description: Stage-length rule violations found by servtuner validate. The run still ran; the analyzer marks the affected stages.

stageLengthRule.description: Which stage-length rule was broken. warmup_duration is the warmup rule (at least 2 x the interval and 30s) and carries no stage_index; percentile_sample_count is Rule A and carries percentile and required_requests.

scrapeWarningRule.description: missing_scrape_role: Prometheus has no job with the role, so series of that role may be missing or scraped more slowly than reported.

stage_index.description: Absent for the warmup_duration rule, required for every other rule.

required_duration_seconds.description: The minimum length the rule demands of the stage (or of the warmup).

scrape_interval_seconds.description: The scrape interval the rule was evaluated with: that of the slowest relevant job.

job.description: The Prometheus job whose interval limits resolution. Absent when the interval was assumed.

percentile.description: Rule A: the percentile that lacks samples.

required_requests.description: Rule A: requests the stage needs for that percentile.

stage_index.description: Zero-based; present when kind is stage.
